context:

name: Get Recent Zone Scans
description: Get Recent Zone Scans Returns the most recent on-demand scans for a specific zone, up to a maximum of 5. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/security-center/insights/scans
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/security-center/insights/scans
Returns the most recent on-demand scans for a specific zone, up to a maximum of 5. Each scan includes its ID, start time, and current status. Results include both zone-specific scans and account-wide scans (which cover all zones). Also returns quota information showing how many scans have been used and how many remain in the current 24-hour window.
Required: zone_id (path)

name: Retrieves Zone Audit Log

context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/security-center/insights/audit-log
Lists audit log entries for all Security Center insights in a specific zone, showing changes to insight status and classification.
Required: zone_id (path)
Optional: per_page (query) — Number of results per page.; cursor (query) — Opaque cursor for pagination. Use the cursor value from result_info of the previous response.; field_changed (query) — Filter by the field that was changed.; changed_by (query) — Filter by the actor that made the change.; since (query) — Filter entries changed at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).; before (query) — Filter entries changed before this timestamp (RFC 3339).; order (query) — Sort order for results. Use 'asc' for oldest first or 'desc' for newest first.

name: Updates Zone Security Center Insight Classification
description: Updates Zone Security Center Insight Classification Updates the user classification for a zone-specific Security Center insight. PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/security-center/insights/{issue_id}/classification
context:
PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/security-center/insights/{issue_id}/classification
Updates the user classification for a zone-specific Security Center insight. Valid values are 'false_positive' or 'accept_risk'. To reset, set classification to null. Cannot change directly between classification values - must reset to null first.
Required: zone_id (path); issue_id (path); body (body)
